answer: Dishonest graders are slashed and their stake is redistributed, which means a Sybil cluster that tries to vote as a bloc will, on average, lose more from slashing than it gains from manipulating a single verdict. This means an attacker must choose: either run a few high-quality identities, or many worthless ones — and neither option beats honest participation.. This holds because each vote is weighted by a track record that only grows through honest participation, turning a Sybil flood into short-lived, low-weight votes.
